Đã lưu [V01](docs/design/history/v1-v01-2026-10-23/acceptance-v01.json) và ánh xạ thành [VA01–VA14](docs/design/v1-acceptance-matrix.md). Các ca chưa được chạy để nghiệm thu V1.

❓ **Q1 — Bạn xác nhận bộ tiêu chí này đủ rõ và kết thúc phiên S02 về phạm vi/nghiệm thu V1?**

➡️ **Đề xuất: đồng ý.** Phần tiếp theo là thiết kế kỹ thuật runtime/SQLite/MCP cho Paseo 0.12.

Bước xác nhận cuối theo [grilling/SKILL.md](/Users/hanhnt2/.codex/plugins/cache/mattpocock/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/productivity/grilling/SKILL.md): “Do not act on it until the user confirms you have reached a shared understanding.”

acceptedScope: The six first-V1 evidence groups accepted at V01 and their VA01–VA14 mapping, including one bounded controlled improvement case and truthful missing/inconclusive operational conclusions. Later incremental patches retain Fast/Deep policy.
continuation: Detailed technical design for Paseo 0.12, including runtime, SQLite and MCP; no production implementation by this confirmation.
excludes: V1 test pass or product readiness; all full-V1 cases remain unexecuted
migration or resumption of the live HBU plugin
history: The original P1270 gate was unanswered at that historical audit. V01 newly accepted its contents; V02 explicitly closes this resumed session. Historical evidence is preserved.
